alternatives: jointly trained ensemble at equal FLOPs
design_space.why_material: Evaluation is untimed (up to 5 s) and may use multiple jointly trained components.

design_space.current_assumption: Bias-free linear head, logit scale 1/6, flatten-max pool.
alternatives: annealed log-sum-exp pooling at low resolution
design_space.why_material: The logit scale mattered (F-019): head geometry is live.
Smoothing level is flat (F-022) but its shape is untested.

alternatives: overlapping 3x3 stride-2 pools on odd maps
design_space.why_material: Every stage discards a row and column of conv output.

design_space.current_assumption: Triangular lr, cubic lookahead decay every 5 steps, warm-up 23%.
alternatives: momentum reset or resolution blend at the switch
design_space.why_material: Gains must come from early and mid-run steps.

design_space.current_assumption: fp16 weights and momentum updated in place.
design_space.why_material: Late updates fall below fp16 resolution; wd x0.5 costs 1.15 pp.
Train/test distribution mismatch matters in this network (F-009).

design_space.current_assumption: max-autotune CUDA graphs, cross-entropy outside the graph.
design_space.why_material: Every exact time saving converts directly into score.

hypotheses.proposition: A snapshot ensemble raises single-view accuracy at no timed cost.
hypotheses.mechanism: Averaging earlier weights from the same run in the untimed evaluation.

hypotheses.proposition: A jointly trained ensemble at equal FLOPs beats one wide net.
hypotheses.mechanism: Two narrower nets trained on the same batches; ensembles are more accurate per FLOP at convergence.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Gain below the 1 pp per 12% exchange rate.

hypotheses.proposition: A stage-2 exit head improves accuracy.
hypotheses.mechanism: Deep supervision plus evaluation-time averaging.
hypotheses.decision_changed: Whether to keep an aux head.

hypotheses.proposition: A closed-form ridge refit of the head improves accuracy.
hypotheses.mechanism: Optimal linear head on final features in one solve.
hypotheses.decision_changed: Whether train ends with a refit.

hypotheses.proposition: A warmup-stable-decay schedule beats the triangle.
hypotheses.mechanism: Holding peak lr longer, through the 32 px switch.

hypotheses.proposition: Lookahead cadence or power changes help.
hypotheses.mechanism: Different averaging horizon.

hypotheses.proposition: Class-balanced batches help.
hypotheses.mechanism: Lower-variance gradients across 100 classes.

hypotheses.proposition: Online label smoothing beats uniform smoothing.
hypotheses.mechanism: Smoothing mass follows the model's own class confusions (teacher-free dark knowledge).

hypotheses.proposition: A wide 1x1 expansion before global max-pool adds cheap capacity.
hypotheses.mechanism: More position-wise detectors at the cheapest resolution.

hypotheses.proposition: Border-preserving pooling improves accuracy.
hypotheses.mechanism: Overlapping pools cover every position; ceil mode adds stage-3 positions.
hypotheses.prediction: Overlap +0.05 to 0.2 pp at 0% time; ceil needs +0.4 pp.

hypotheses.proposition: Per-sample temporal soft targets (PS-KD) help.
hypotheses.mechanism: Each image's previous softmax as an instance-specific target, ramped after the switch.

hypotheses.proposition: A cosine head with sub-centres helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Removes the feature-norm shortcut and class-norm imbalance.

hypotheses.proposition: Class-mean head initialisation helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Head starts aligned with dirac-trunk features, saving early steps.

hypotheses.proposition: Annealing label smoothing to 0 helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Smoothing stabilises early; late commitment raises margins.

hypotheses.proposition: Evaluation-time fp32 or resized single-view input helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Removes fp16 ties; resolution convention.

hypotheses.proposition: fp32 master weights recover late-run updates lost to fp16 rounding.
hypotheses.mechanism: Late per-element updates fall below fp16 resolution and round to no update.

hypotheses.proposition: An untranslated clean tail helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Closes the train/test distribution gap in the final low-lr steps.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Both arms at or below control.

hypotheses.proposition: The weight-decay sensitivity sits in one parameter group.
hypotheses.mechanism: Convs are scale-invariant (wd sets effective lr); the head is not (wd sets logit norm).
hypotheses.prediction: One arm gains 0.1 pp or more (about 30%).

hypotheses.proposition: A conv init gain below 1 speeds the approach to rotational equilibrium.
hypotheses.mechanism: Effective lr of scale-invariant weights is lr/|w|^2; smaller init raises the early angular update rate.
hypotheses.prediction: 0 to +0.15 pp, rising as gain falls.

hypotheses.proposition: Softening the 20->32 px switch saves recovery steps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Partial momentum reset or stochastic resolution blend around the switch.

hypotheses.proposition: A fixed simplex-ETF head matches or beats a learned head.
hypotheses.mechanism: Features chase fixed maximally separated targets from step 1 (neural collapse).

hypotheses.proposition: Annealed log-sum-exp pooling in the 20 px phase helps.
hypotheses.mechanism: Dense gradients to all terminal positions early, exact max at 32 px and evaluation.

hypotheses.proposition: Skipping pool-discarded conv outputs saves time exactly.
hypotheses.mechanism: Odd maps lose their last conv row/column to floor pooling; top-left padding with an unpadded conv never computes them.

hypotheses.proposition: Removing the frozen whitening bias from autograd saves time exactly.
hypotheses.mechanism: Drops the 12-channel input-gradient GEMM and GELU backward after freeze.

hypotheses.proposition: Unlimited cuDNN benchmarking finds faster algorithms.
hypotheses.mechanism: Default benchmarking times only 10 candidates.

hypotheses.proposition: Coordinate-descent tuning speeds reduction kernels.
hypotheses.mechanism: Inductor tunes BN/pool block sizes not covered by max-autotune.

hypotheses.proposition: Loss inside the compiled graph saves time.
hypotheses.mechanism: Fuses 12-16 eager cross-entropy kernels into the CUDA graph.

hypotheses.proposition: Padding the whitening output to 16 channels speeds group-1 conv.
hypotheses.mechanism: Tensor-core alignment.

hypotheses.proposition: A fused per-epoch data kernel saves time.
hypotheses.mechanism: One gather instead of per-epoch crops, flips and per-step gathers.

hypotheses.proposition: A whole-step manual CUDA graph saves time.
hypotheses.mechanism: Removes eager optimiser kernels and gaps.

hypotheses.proposition: Autotuning at throttled clocks picks faster kernels.
hypotheses.mechanism: Build-time autotune runs at boost clock.

hypotheses.proposition: A fused Triton pool+BN+GELU kernel saves time.
hypotheses.mechanism: One pass instead of re-reading pooled activations.

hypotheses.proposition: fp16 BatchNorm or bf16 speeds training.
hypotheses.mechanism: Lower precision normalisation.
hypotheses.prediction: Expected to fail: eps 1e-12 underflows in fp16; bf16 has no tensor-core advantage.

hypotheses.proposition: A FreezeOut-style stage-1 cooldown then exact freeze saves time at little cost.
hypotheses.mechanism: Stage 1 converges first; with its lr at zero, skipping its backward is exact.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Accuracy loss above the exchange rate.

hypotheses.proposition: Cutting stage 2's residual conv buys time net of extra epochs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Stage 2 holds 46% of MACs at 32 px and was never cut alone.

hypotheses.proposition: A structured DCT filter-bank start helps the widening convs (legal stand-in for build-time pre-training).
hypotheses.mechanism: Frequency-selective filters from step 0.

hypotheses.proposition: Further compute removal (stage-2 freeze, thinning, weight-only freezes, window crops) saves more.
hypotheses.mechanism: Late work in stages 2-3 is low-yield.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Accuracy loss above the exchange rate.

hypotheses.proposition: Bias decay, square-conv perturbations, head centring or whitening eps add accuracy per step.
hypotheses.mechanism: Size vs noise of BN biases; spatial filtering at init; head curvature.

observations.statement: After T-013 and the T-018 coverage pass every lineage, competitor and representation strategy has a disposition; only flatten-max pooling and max-autotune CUDA graphs survived. The recipe sits at 75.27% over 40 seeds at 6.03 s on A100 PCIe with no remaining hyperparameter lever beyond seed noise.

evidence.label: strategy coverage matrix at T-019 start

observations.statement: S30: ensembles within the untimed evaluation budget, multi-exit and head refit all lose 0.7-1.2 pp; WSD (+0.24 pp) and balanced order (+0.15 pp) are candidates.
Three read-only ideation agents (representation, optimisation dynamics, A100 systems) proposed 29 hypotheses with mechanisms, probes and kill rules.

Ideation round 3 (learning per step, compute removal) proposed further hypotheses after the round-1 and round-2 adoptions; the round-2 budget report is summarised in the conversation record and its hypotheses B1-B2 are listed here.

omitted_dimensions.rationale: Single-view evaluation at a different input resolution is close to test-time augmentation; not pursued without organiser confirmation.

probes.method: 12 configurations at the converged recipe, 10 seeds 2000-2009, in-sweep control.
probes.information_gain: Covers the evaluation-budget, refit, schedule-shape, lookahead and order dimensions in one pass.
probes.decision_rule: Promote arms beyond two combined SE to fresh-seed confirmation; reject the rest.

probes.method: 20 fresh seeds 3300-3319: WSD decay start 0.5/0.6/0.7, balanced order, WSD 0.6 plus balanced, control.
probes.information_gain: Separates real gains from best-of-11 selection.
probes.decision_rule: Adopt if the fresh-seed gain exceeds two combined SE (about 0.16 pp).

probes.method: 28 configurations, 20 shared seeds 3000-3019, in-sweep control (batch B and C levers).
probes.information_gain: Screens every zero- or low-cost accuracy lever of ideation round 1 at the detection limit (SE of a paired difference about 0.08 pp).
probes.decision_rule: Promote arms at +0.10 pp or more to fresh-seed confirmation; time-costing arms must beat the exchange rate.

probes.method: GPU smoke of all exact systems levers under max-autotune, 2 seeds.
probes.information_gain: Catches compile or CUDA-graph failures before paid A100 time.
probes.decision_rule: Proceed to M5 only if the combined arm builds, trains and matches control accuracy.

probes.method: Modal A100 same-host interleave: 7 arms x 2 hosts x 2 alternating-order blocks x 5 seeds; paired differences against control within host-block.
probes.information_gain: Measures exact savings free of the 1.5-9% host-to-host variance.
probes.decision_rule: Adopt a lever if its paired saving is consistent across host-blocks and exceeds two SE; exact levers need no accuracy rerun beyond a 40-seed final check.

probes.method: BN-bias scaler scan and epoch ladder; structured-init screen and 40-seed confirmation.
probes.information_gain: Turns accuracy levers into epoch cuts.
probes.decision_rule: Adopt if 40 fresh seeds hold control accuracy at a shorter budget.

probes.method: Freeze and depth screen, 40-seed confirmations, local paired timing in opposite arm order on two GPUs, submission check.
probes.information_gain: Prices structural cuts in time and accuracy.
probes.decision_rule: Adopt at control accuracy if the paired saving exceeds 5%.

probes.method: Round-3 agent hypotheses and re-tuning on the D-012 base, 20 seeds each.
probes.information_gain: Tests whether the converged entry has headroom.
probes.decision_rule: Promote at a net gain above the exchange rate.

question: Do structural, learning-dynamics or A100 systems levers outside the climbed parameter space lower A100 PCIe time to a 75.2% single-view mean beyond seed and host noise?
synthesis: Converged. Adopted: whitening-bias autograd removal (-2.96% PCIe), BN-bias scaler 16 (buys 0.25 epoch), DCT init of the widening convs (buys 0.25 epoch), and the exact stage-1 freeze with stage 2 at depth 2 (-10.7% local paired time) at 8.5 epochs. The entry qualified at 5.526 s on A100 PCIe before the last change and holds about 75.17% over 100 seeds. Rejected: ensembles, refits, soft targets, head geometry, data pruning, saliency narrowing, Muon (teammates' port slower on the same hosts), further freezes, thinning, weight-only freezes, window crops, bias-decay and init variants. Remaining work is confirmation, not exploration.
